title: SustainablePowerPLAY
tagline: Using safe 4337 module for sponsored "PowerPLAY lottery" ticket claims on BASE.
description:
Using safe 4337 module for sponsored PowerPLAY "lottery" ticket claims on BASE. We set up a safe with the 4337 account abstraction module that allows us to execute sponsored ticket claims without the user paying gas.

Check the pull request in our repo for details the file "app/mintToken.ts": https://github.com/fairylabs/powerplay/pull/1/files#diff-3787cbca35cdc28e9ff0f1619d81e74755aa5a681f1e6c3e26a81e693aefbd5d 

Safe used: https://app.safe.global/home?safe=base:0x3dE07A228E3cb053cd50Ddc7cCB7a20fd59Ee879
